Con facturación on-demand cada consulta: With on-demand billing every query is charged for the bytes of the columns it reads across the whole table, even when filtering. Con la opción activa el log se vacía en: With the option on, the log is emptied at every checkpoint: DUMP TRANSACTION can't be done nor can you restore to a point in time. Fine for development databases; in production, turn it off and schedule log dumps.
